hooks.name: Guard against raw-genotype leaks in writes
hooks.description: Prompts a privacy review before file-write tools to prevent raw genotype/allele values from leaking into logs or transmitted payloads.

action.prompt: Before this write, check the content against the privacy rules in .kiro/steering/guardrails.md: raw genetic data (alleles, genotypes) must never be written into logs, analytics, error reports, URLs, or any transmitted payload. If this write would place raw genotype/allele values into any of those sinks, stop and use a sanitized, non-identifying summary instead.
